description: Kernel A (Morse-Smale field-solve) parity gates, lifted verbatim from the inline check_parity.py gate dicts (006 'Determinism gates'). atol is NEVER widened past 1e-3; a larger drift is a real op divergence to surface. This is the reference implementation of the <k>_gates.json schema molt proposed to pact in 011 §2b.
provenance: numpy-fp32 authority regenerated by make_fixture.py + field_solve.py under numpy 1.26.4 / scipy 1.17.1; H=384 W=512.

sdf_argmax.note: argmax(phi) == lstar; integer label, bit-exact required

sdf_margin_m12.note: top1-top2 SDF margin; EDT floats, atol 1e-3

sdf_gap13.note: top1-top3 triple-junction proximity; EDT floats, atol 1e-3

boundary.note: inter-class boundary mask; integer, bit-exact required

crit_max_rc.note: index-2 maxima (<=40 rows); enumeration order impl-specific -> row-set compare

crit_min_rc.note: index-0 minima on boundary (<=120 rows); row-set compare

crit_saddle_eigvec.note: (c,r,dx,dy) separatrix tangents; rows keyed by self-coords (c,r) then atol 1e-3
